hints.title: Check Both Combinations
hints.text: Test if a prefix of a and suffix of b form a palindrome, or vice versa.

hints.title: Match Opposing Ends
hints.text: Advance inward from both ends while prefix character matches suffix character.

hints.title: Remaining Middle Substring
hints.text: When characters differ, check if remaining inner substring of either string is itself a palindrome.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of strings a and b
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all n possible split locations and verifying palindrome takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two-pointer inward scan eliminates redundant splits in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice symmetry and write a helper function called twice.

solutions.approach: Two pointer inward scan with middle palindrome validation
